title: wg: room-policy-04 §4 PreAuthRoleEntry embeds a whole Role
description: Suggestion. L470 "Role target_role;" is a full Role, not a role index; nothing says what happens if it differs from the roles_list entry with the same role_index. mimid uses its role_index and treats roles_list as authoritative (decision mimid-1wgh.3.16). Fix: use a RoleIndex.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: PreAuthRoleEntry embeds whole Role, relation to roles_list undefined. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/28
